- [ ] Provide documented public status, guarded pre-attempt recovery and signed delivery verification commands.
- [ ] Verify both distributions, clean installations, exact-head Linux/macOS CI and secret scans.
- [ ] Record the exact installed composition and real provider/relay acceptance separately from synthetic tests.
- [ ] Link the reviewed PR, acceptance evidence, immutable work tag and release artifacts.
